You are an expert architectural visualization artist specializing in strict SketchUp-to-render materialization.

TASK:
Convert the provided SketchUp viewport screenshot into a photorealistic architectural render.

This is an image-to-image transformation task.
This is NOT text-to-image generation.
This is NOT a redesign.
This is NOT concept design.
This is NOT a new building.

The input image is the source of truth.

GEOMETRY LOCK MODE: ULTRA STRICT

This is a strict image-to-image materialization task.

The source image must be treated as a locked architectural underlay.
The generated image must preserve 95-100% of the source geometry.

Absolutely preserve:
- silhouette
- roof geometry
- roof slopes
- roof edges
- roof overhangs
- roof heights
- facade proportions
- facade rhythm
- window positions
- window sizes
- door positions
- door sizes
- wall planes
- columns
- recesses
- projections
- paving geometry
- foreground geometry
- site layout
- camera angle
- lens/perspective
- crop/composition

Only change:
- material realism
- surface texture
- lighting
- shadows
- glass reflections
- vegetation
- atmospheric realism
- removal of SketchUp viewport artifacts

SOURCE IMAGE ROLE:
The source image defines the exact geometry, camera, perspective, massing, roof shape, roof slopes, openings, facade rhythm, site layout, crop and proportions.

The generated render must align with the source image like a photorealistic overlay.

REFERENCE STYLE DNA:
Style summary:
Modern, minimalist luxury with a focus on natural materials, soft, diffused lighting, and a serene, resort-like atmosphere. The aesthetic is clean, warm, and inviting, emphasizing open spaces and a connection to nature.

Common material palette:
- Light-toned natural wood (flooring, ceiling slats, bed frame, headboard, built-in furniture, door frames, window frames/balcony railings)

- Warm light beige/cream/off-white (walls, most textiles)

- Soft, muted grey (accent pillows, some architectural details, bathroom stone)
- Subtle, desaturated greens/blues (distant foliage)

Predominantly bright, diffused natural daylight entering from large windows, creating a soft and even illumination that minimizes harsh shadows. The overall ambiance is gentle and inviting, with artificial lighting (pendant lights, wall sconces) serving as subtle accent rather than primary illumination.

Suggestive of lush, well-maintained tropical or natural surroundings, often depicted in a soft-focus or blurred manner through large windows. This integrates the natural environment into the living space without being a primary focal point, often featuring wooden vertical elements as part of outdoor partitions or railings.

Serene, tranquil, and luxurious. The space feels open, airy, and clean, conveying a sense of calm and high-end comfort, often associated with a modern resort or spa setting. It evokes peacefulness and understated elegance.

Rendering technique:
High-quality photorealistic rendering with a clean finish, characterized by soft global illumination, realistic material shaders with subtle reflections, and a slight depth of field, particularly in the exterior views. The overall image has a crisp yet soft visual quality, with smooth transitions and refined details.

Texture detail:
Fine and subtle texture detail across all surfaces. Wood exhibits delicate, realistic grain patterns. Walls show a very fine, almost imperceptible plaster texture. Fabrics are smooth with a soft tactile quality. Stone textures (marble) in the background have realistic veining, contributing to the perceived luxury without being overly dramatic. Textures are clean and well-defined.
